nodes.label: Spring AI Alibaba Multimodal Demo
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates multimodal (vision) capabilities using DashScope models for image understanding, image generation, and TTS.

nodes.label: qwen-vl-plus Vision Model
nodes.rationale: Default vision model for multimodal image understanding.

nodes.label: ChatModel (Spring AI)
nodes.rationale: Core Spring AI interface for chat-based LLM interaction; supports media input for multimodal use.

nodes.label: UserMessage.media (Image Input API)
nodes.rationale: Key Spring AI API for attaching images to user messages; accepts Media objects with URLs or local resources.

nodes.label: ReactAgent
nodes.rationale: Agent framework component that accepts multimodal UserMessage input and can use tools for image generation.

nodes.label: GenerateImageTool
nodes.rationale: Tool wrapping ImageModel for use by ReactAgent; supports outputFormat parameter (url vs base64).

nodes.label: DashScopeAudioSpeechModel
nodes.rationale: Used directly (not as a tool) for TTS; supports call() and stream() methods.

nodes.label: AudioService
nodes.rationale: Service wrapping DashScopeAudioSpeechModel; selects call() or stream() based on model support; outputFormat controls url vs base64.

nodes.label: ToolMultimodalResult
nodes.rationale: Reuses org.springframework.ai.content.Media for structured JSON tool results; supports URL, raw bytes, and URL+base64 formats.

nodes.label: Output Format: URL
nodes.rationale: Default output format; model-friendly with minimal token usage; preferred for agent reasoning loops.

nodes.label: Output Format: base64
nodes.rationale: Inline data for client consumption (e.g., returnDirect=true); significantly increases token usage when sent to model.

nodes.label: Checkpoint/Resume Limitation
nodes.rationale: Media may not persist in Graph state serialization when checkpointing or resuming.

nodes.label: Studio API Pipeline Limitation
nodes.rationale: Media field may be stripped in Studio's API pipeline.

nodes.label: sample.png Test Image Resource
nodes.rationale: Sample image file used for testing Scenario 2 (Image from Local Resource); users can replace with their own image.

nodes.label: multi-model: true Flag
nodes.rationale: REQUIRED to enable vision (multimodal) capabilities in DashScope chat models.
